What do Americans actually buy in Korea?

Korea's 2025 International Visitor Survey asked 1,152 US visitors at airports and ports on their way out. Among those who went shopping, here is what they bought:

1. Skincare and perfume: 57.2%
2. Clothes: 52.1%
3. Food and snacks: 45.9%
4. Jewelry and accessories: 25.7%
5. Traditional crafts: 22.9%
6. Shoes: 14.6%
7. Ginseng: 10.6%
8. Bags: 9.5%
9. K-pop merch: 8.0%
10. Liquor: 6.1%

Skincare and perfume was also the biggest slice of what they spent on shopping: 27.7%.

Been to Korea? What did you buy, and what was actually worth it? Tell me in the comments so the next person can plan their list.

Source: Korea Tourism Organization and Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, 2025 International Visitor Survey, final report (May 2026), Table 168 (items bought, US visitors who shopped, multiple answers) and Table 169 (share of shopping spend). Report checked Nov 28, 2026, 11:36 KST. Not sponsored.
